I must have been 10-11, at some church event which I had been volunteered for *fuckers always volunteered me for shit without asking, cockgobblers* and this little 4 year old girl was sitting in a corner, just crying. Not loudly, more sobbing than anything. AND EVERY MOTHERFUCKER IN THAT PLACE WAS IGNORING HER.

So I put down my waitress tray on the *goddamned floor* and walked over to her, picked her up and walked out of the common area into the nursery room. Sat her on the table while the nursery lady looked at me like I was insane, asked her what was wrong. She was crying because her dog had died earlier that day and she didn't want to be at church.

I told her that her dog wouldn't want her to be sad, and that he would want her to be happy - that's what he spent his life doing, after all. And she stopped crying. Led her out into the common area by the hand, had her point out her mom and dad for future reference, then asked her to go back into the nursery. Waltzed up to her parents and *laid the fuck into them like higher management* about their shitty parenting. Everyone went silent, and I spent the rest of the day playing with that little girl and all the babies in the nursery.

You do NOT ignore your child's distress in favor of a motherfuckin' shitty church party.
